# anypoint_agent_instance (Resource)

Manages an Agent instance in Anypoint API Manager. An Agent instance represents an Agent specification deployed to an Omni Gateway target with routing rules and upstream backends.

Under the hood this is the same API Manager `.../apis` endpoint used by [`anypoint_apim_mule4`](apim_mule4.md), distinguished by `endpoint.type = "a2a"` (Agent-to-Agent) and `technology = "omniGateway"` (sent to the platform as `flexGateway`). For an MCP server instance, use [`anypoint_mcp_server`](mcp_server.md) instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anypoint_agent_instance" "agent" {
  org_id = var.root_org
  env_id = var.environment_id

  instance_label = "my-agent"
  gateway_id     = anypoint_managed_omni_gateway.gateway.id

  spec {
    asset_id = "my-agent-spec"
    group_id = var.root_org
    version  = "1.0.0"
  }

  endpoint {
    deployment_type = "CH2"
    base_path       = "my-agent"
  }

  upstream_uri = "http://my-agent-backend.internal:8080"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `env_id` (String) The environment id where this instance is defined.
- `org_id` (String) The organization id where this instance is defined.
- `spec` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) The Exchange asset specification backing this instance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec))

### Optional

- `approval_method` (String) Client approval method. Valid values: 'manual'. Omit for no approval required.
- `consumer_endpoint` (String) Consumer-facing endpoint URI (the public URL clients use to reach this instance).
- `deployment` (Block List, Max: 1) Deployment target configuration. Auto-populated when 'gateway_id' is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--deployment))
- `endpoint` (Block List, Max: 1) Endpoint / proxy configuration for this instance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--endpoint))
- `gateway_id` (String) The Managed Omni Gateway id. When provided (and 'deployment' is omitted), the deployment block is auto-populated from this gateway's details.
- `instance_label` (String) A human-readable label for this instance.
- `last_updated` (String) The last time this resource has been updated locally.
- `provider_id` (String) The identity provider id to use for this instance.
- `routing` (Block List) Routing rules with weighted upstream backends. Mutually exclusive with 'upstream_uri'. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--routing))
- `technology` (String) The gateway technology. Only 'omniGateway' is currently supported. Defaults to `omniGateway`.
- `upstream_uri` (String) Shorthand for a single-upstream routing configuration with weight 100. Mutually exclusive with 'routing'.

### Read-Only

- `asset_id` (String) The Exchange asset id (mirrors spec.asset_id after creation).
- `asset_version` (String) The Exchange asset version (mirrors spec.version after creation).
- `id` (String) The numeric identifier of this instance (stored as string for Terraform compatibility).
- `product_version` (String) The product (major) version, computed from the asset version.
- `status` (String) The current status of this instance.

<a id="nestedblock--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `asset_id` (String) The Exchange asset id.
- `group_id` (String) The Exchange group (organization) id.
- `version` (String) The asset version.

<a id="nestedblock--endpoint"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoint`

Optional:

- `base_path` (String) Base path (e.g. 'my-agent'). The provider constructs the full proxy URI as `http://0.0.0.0:8081/<base_path>`. Mutually exclusive with `uri`.
- `deployment_type` (String) Deployment type. Valid values: 'HY' (hybrid), 'CH' (CloudHub), 'CH2' (CloudHub 2.0), 'RF' (Runtime Fabric). Defaults to `HY`.
- `response_timeout` (Number) Response timeout in milliseconds.
- `uri` (String) Direct implementation URI (e.g. 'http://www.google.com'). Mutually exclusive with `base_path`.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Endpoint protocol type. Always 'a2a' (Agent-to-Agent) for agent instances.

<a id="nestedblock--deployment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployment`

Optional:

- `environment_id` (String) The environment id for deployment (usually matches the top-level env_id).
- `expected_status` (String) Expected deployment status. Valid values: 'deployed', 'undeployed'. Defaults to `deployed`.
- `overwrite` (Boolean) Whether to overwrite an existing deployment.
- `target_id` (String) The target gateway id to deploy to.
- `type` (String) Deployment type. Valid values: 'HY', 'CH', 'RF'. Defaults to `HY`.

Read-Only:

- `gateway_version` (String) The Omni Gateway runtime version.
- `target_name` (String) The target gateway name.

<a id="nestedblock--routing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routing`

Required:

- `upstreams` (Block List, Min: 1) Weighted upstream backends for this route. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--routing--upstreams))

Optional:

- `label` (String) A label for this route.
- `rules` (Block List, Max: 1) Match conditions for this route (methods, path, headers). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--routing--rules))

<a id="nestedblock--routing--upstreams"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routing.upstreams`

Required:

- `uri` (String) The upstream backend URI.

Optional:

- `label` (String) A label for this upstream.
- `tls_context_id` (String) TLS context for upstream connections. Format: 'secretGroupId/tlsContextId'.
- `weight` (Number) Traffic weight percentage (0-100). Weights across upstreams should sum to 100. Defaults to `100`.

<a id="nestedblock--routing--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routing.rules`

Optional:

- `headers` (Map of String) Header key-value pairs to match.
- `host` (String) Host header value to match.
- `methods` (String) Pipe-separated HTTP methods (e.g. 'GET', 'POST|PUT').
- `path` (String) URL path pattern to match (e.g. '/api/*').

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# In order for the import to work, you should provide a composite ID:
#  {ORG_ID}/{ENV_ID}/{INSTANCE_ID}

terraform import \
  -var-file params.tfvars.json \                          #variables file
  anypoint_agent_instance.agent \                         #resource name
  47ec5a2c-c3ce-4994-af2e-11ed525c5b78/e60d1779-13eb-4892-9fb3-803087c14988/12345 #composite id
```
